title: Rethinking Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation: From Alignment Coverage to Supervision Reliability
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations using teacher feedback. title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training.
